implementation: Phase 2 Recovery Manager: charge-by-charge fee dispute investigation using deterministic evidence matching plus AI reasoning (Gemini, fail-open). Each charge is assessed via the Phase 2 IntelligentInvestigationRunner: evidence health check → AI reasoning → deterministic validation guard. Semantics: CONTRADICTS=FAIL (claim), SUPPORTS=PASS (no claim), SILENT=UNCERTAIN (never claims). Implements findings F-07 to F-12 explicitly. Integrates Breeth intent memory (fail-open).
notes: Implements the EVIDENCE-CONTRACT.md Recovery semantics: check condition is 'this charge is supported by evidence'. SILENT (insufficient evidence) never becomes a claim. AI reasoning is constrained by deterministic validation to prevent hallucinated claims. Phase 2 investigation graph and timeline are produced per workflow.
